headline: values of different types are combined
reason: Comparing or combining values of different types is an error (reference 3).

primary.label: expected Option(Int), found Int or BigInt or Byte or Decimal or Float

headline: a name isn't visible in this block
reason: A local name is visible from its binding to the end of its block (reference 6.1).

headline: arithmetic is used on a type without Number
reason: Only Int, BigInt, Decimal and Float have Number; times and durations also add and subtract (reference 9.2).

primary.label: expected Int or BigInt or Decimal or Float, found Text

headline: a visible name is bound again
reason: While a local name or parameter is visible it can't be bound again (reference 6.1).

primary.label: this name already has a meaning

secondary.label: the other meaning of this name
